statement: Pinned Cemu reads A600FA/6 but matches response solely by low 16-bit FA, sharing handler with A400FA. Its builtin inactive A4200005 branch only notes inactive MP, while external A6200005 branch activates with A600F0=55 and A600FE=04. Status also branches to EEPROM 0016/8, optional normal A400FA/6, and Cemu reads A40020/16 child calibration rather than F6/40. This pinned consumer limitation does not authorize inventing external identity for a retail TR Plus or claiming decoded gyro.

applicability.revision: TR/Gen 2 pinned consumer paths; no retail or firmware revision measured
